sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:64

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:64:1
items.html: Also from Butzina de Kardinuta [the lamp of darkness], which is the Gevura of Atik, there came out from it one spark, and this spark was hidden in the womb of Ima: And it is likewise from the discernment of the root of the Gevurot, which is the discernment of the Malchut of restriction one, as above regarding Mocha Stimaa [the concealed brain] at length — study it there well. And this Gevura is likewise in concealment in the upper Ima, as in Atik and in Mocha Stimaa, for it does not serve with her in her middle line; rather, the reflected light that rises from the coupling upon her screen in the middle line draws illumination from it, in the manner explained above regarding the Gevura of Atik and Mocha Stimaa — study it there well.
